[{"type":"GeneralTitle","content":"Bachelor of Arts Major in Political Science","groupId":"329b9e4a-8a89-48a6-ba3a-0194b9381d21","position":0,"area":"General"},{"type":"GeneralText","content":"

Students must complete a minimum of 120 units with a Pacific cumulative and major/program grade point average of 2.0 in order to earn the Bachelor of Arts degree with a major in political science.

","groupId":"26747971-7d03-4cff-a60c-0194b9381d21","position":1,"area":"General"},{"type":"GeneralTitle","content":"General Education Requirements","groupId":"cb1472e7-4fbd-4daf-a42c-0194b94558cf","position":2,"area":"General"},{"type":"GeneralText","content":"

For more details, see General Education

Minimum 28 units and 9 courses that include the following requirements.

","groupId":"b1c56726-fbd7-45a9-824a-0194b94558cf","position":3,"area":"General"},{"type":"GeneralTitle","content":"Core Requirements","groupId":"f62b57b8-cddc-43ee-b32b-0194b94d848b","position":4,"area":"General"},{"type":"GeneralText","content":"

Notes:

1) CORE Seminars cannot be taken for Pass/No Credit. 

2) Transfer students with 28 or more transfer credits taken after high school are exempt from both CORE seminars.

3) Students participating in the First Year Honors Program should complete an honors section of CORE 001 regardless of the number of college transfer units completed. 

","groupId":"aaf4b535-b765-47f8-bc28-0194b94d848b","position":5,"area":"General"},{"type":"GeneralTitle","content":" Breadth Requirement (7 courses, at least 3 units each)","groupId":"1e1162d0-0f7d-4ceb-9f52-0194b94d848b","position":6,"area":"General"},{"type":"GeneralText","content":"

Notes:

1) No more than 2 courses from a single discipline can be used to meet the Breadth Requirement

2) Students must complete 60 units outside the primary discipline of the first major, regardless of the department who offers the course(s) in that discipline. (Courses include general education courses, transfer courses, CPCE/EXTN units, internships, etc.)

","groupId":"158d35c5-1bff-4968-910c-0194b94d848b","position":7,"area":"General"},{"type":"GeneralTitle","content":"Diversity and Inclusion Requirement","groupId":"d0fe901d-b127-4a2c-b561-0194b94e08b7","position":8,"area":"General"},{"type":"GeneralText","content":"

All students must complete Diversity and Inclusion coursework (at least 3 units)

Note: Diversity and Inclusion courses can also be used to meet the breadth category requirements, or major or minor requirements.

","groupId":"d1b77534-35c6-4db8-be18-0194b94e08b7","position":9,"area":"General"},{"type":"GeneralTitle","content":"Fundamental Skills","groupId":"ea74d9eb-c065-46a0-a355-0194b94e880f","position":10,"area":"General"},{"type":"GeneralText","content":"

Students must demonstrate competence in:

Writing

Quantitative Analysis (Math)

Note: Failure to satisfy the fundamental skills requirements by the end of four semesters of full-time study at the University is grounds for academic disqualification.

","groupId":"7ecb58de-6cc4-4c3a-9b13-0194b94e8810","position":11,"area":"General"},{"type":"GeneralTitle","content":"College of the Pacific BA Requirement","groupId":"e2235bb8-a6a7-46e8-a6af-0194b94ef526","position":12,"area":"General"},{"type":"GeneralText","content":"

Students must complete one year of college instruction or equivalent training in a language other than English.

Note:  Transfer students with sophomore standing are exempt from this requirement.

","groupId":"67438c71-7f33-40d8-a313-0194b94ef526","position":13,"area":"General"},{"type":"GeneralTitle","content":"Major Requirements","groupId":"626acc1c-8f0c-4893-b4ec-0194b9575fa6","position":14,"area":"General"},{"type":"GeneralText","content":"

Notes:

1) Only students who participate in an approved study-abroad program may take INTL 151—Cross-Cultural Training I.

2) Students may meet the Political Science major's experiential learning requirement by participating in an approved education abroad program

3) Any SABD (education abroad) course may be used to satisfy the experiential learning requirement.

4) At least six (6) upper-division Political Science Courses (100-180), with at least one course from four (4) of the subfields in sections 3A-3H.
